SKU.cardinality_notes: 1:N with SalesHistory, InventorySnapshot, SupplierSKU, Forecast, ReorderPolicy, PurchaseRecommendation

fields.name: sku_id
fields.validation_rule: Must match SKU-XXXXXX and be unique
fields.description: Primary key for Stock Keeping Unit

fields.name: category
fields.allowed_values: Beverages, Dairy, Bakery, Pantry, Produce, Frozen, Personal Care, Household

fields.name: discontinue_date
fields.description: Date product was retired if discontinued

Store.cardinality_notes: 1:N with SalesHistory, InventorySnapshot, Forecast, ReorderPolicy, PurchaseRecommendation

fields.name: store_id
fields.validation_rule: Must match STORE-XXXXXX and be unique

fields.name: max_storage_units
fields.description: Maximum unit capacity threshold of store backroom/shelves

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.validation_rule: Must match SUPP-XXXX and be unique

SupplierSKU.cardinality_notes: N:M Bridge table between Supplier (1:N) and SKU (1:N). 1:N with LeadTimeObservation

fields.name: supplier_sku_id
fields.description: Primary key for vendor-SKU contract relation

fields.name: moq_units
fields.validation_rule: Must be positive integer and multiple of pack_size

fields.name: lead_time_std_days
fields.description: Standard deviation of delivery lead times

fields.name: is_primary
fields.validation_rule: Exactly one primary supplier per SKU
fields.description: Indicator for primary source of supply

SalesHistory.cardinality_notes: N:1 with Store, N:1 with SKU. Daily transactions / demand log

fields.name: date
fields.validation_rule: Valid ISO date within observation window

fields.name: units_sold
fields.validation_rule: Integer >= 0. Must be 0 if stockout occurred at day start

fields.name: promo_discount_pct
fields.validation_rule: 0.0 if promotion_flag is False, > 0 if True

fields.name: stockout_flag
fields.description: True if zero on-hand prevented full demand fulfillment

fields.name: unconstrained_demand_est
fields.description: True unconstrained demand before inventory censoring

fields.name: lost_sales_units
fields.description: Sales lost due to stockout censoring

fields.name: unit_selling_price
fields.description: Actual price charged per unit after discount

InventorySnapshot.cardinality_notes: N:1 with Store, N:1 with SKU. Daily end-of-day stock positions

fields.name: opening_on_hand_qty
fields.description: Stock on shelf/backroom at day start

fields.name: received_qty
fields.description: Stock delivered from POs during day

fields.name: closing_on_hand_qty
fields.description: End of day physical stock on hand

fields.name: on_order_qty
fields.description: Stock in transit or committed on open purchase orders

fields.name: reserved_qty
fields.description: Stock allocated to pending customer click-and-collect

fields.name: stockout_flag
fields.description: Binary indicator of zero stockout state

fields.name: days_of_supply
fields.description: Runway of stock based on average daily velocity

LeadTimeObservation.cardinality_notes: N:1 with Supplier, N:1 with SKU, N:1 with SupplierSKU. Historical PO lead-time receipts

fields.name: observation_id
fields.description: Primary key for lead time fulfillment event

fields.name: order_date
fields.description: Date PO was dispatched to vendor

Forecast.cardinality_notes: N:1 with Store, N:1 with SKU. Statistical demand projections per SKU-store

fields.name: forecast_date
fields.validation_rule: Valid ISO date as-of forecast run

fields.name: forecasted_daily_std
fields.description: Estimated standard deviation of daily demand

fields.name: method
fields.description: Statistical model used to generate estimate

fields.name: promo_uplift_factor
fields.description: Anticipated lift factor for planned promotions

fields.name: stockout_uncensored
fields.description: Whether lost sales imputation was applied to training data

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: System timestamp when forecast was written

ReorderPolicy.cardinality_notes: 1:1 per SKU-Store active horizon. Governs replenishment triggers

fields.name: service_level
fields.description: Target cycle service level probability (1 - Stockout Risk)

fields.name: z_factor
fields.validation_rule: Inverse standard normal CDF of service_level

fields.name: lead_time_demand
fields.description: Expected mean sales during fulfillment window

fields.name: safety_stock_units
fields.description: Buffer stock protecting against demand & lead time variance

fields.name: reorder_point_units
fields.description: Inventory position threshold triggering replenishment order

fields.name: review_period_days
fields.description: Frequency of replenishment review in days

fields.name: max_store_capacity_units
fields.description: Hard shelf/backroom allocation ceiling for this SKU-store

PurchaseRecommendation.cardinality_notes: N:1 with Store, N:1 with SKU, N:1 with Supplier. 1:N with OrderLifecycleEvent

fields.name: supplier_id
fields.description: Foreign key to vendor providing goods

fields.name: recommendation_date
fields.description: Date recommendation was generated by engine

fields.name: current_on_order_qty
fields.description: Inventory already on order with supplier

fields.name: gross_need_units
fields.description: Deficit needed to reach target stock level

fields.name: unrounded_order_qty
fields.description: Required order quantity before pack-size rounding

fields.name: pack_size_applied
fields.description: Pack size multiple applied for rounding

fields.name: capacity_constrained_qty
fields.validation_rule: Order quantity respecting store storage limits
fields.description: Quantity capped by store backroom/shelf capacity

fields.name: final_order_qty
fields.validation_rule: Must be multiple of pack_size and >= MOQ if ordered, unless exception

fields.name: total_cost
fields.description: Total financial commitment for this purchase recommendation

fields.name: exception_code
fields.allowed_values: NONE, ERR_DISCONTINUED_SKU, ERR_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, ERR_PACK_SIZE_MISMATCH, ERR_NEGATIVE_LEAD_TIME, ERR_SUPPLIER_INACTIVE
fields.description: Audit error code if rule condition violated

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Plain language operational justification and math trace

OrderLifecycleEvent.cardinality_notes: N:1 with PurchaseRecommendation. Audit trail preserving state transitions

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Primary key for event audit record

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Actor who triggered the state change

fields.name: action
fields.allowed_values: GENERATE, APPROVE, OVERRIDE_QTY, REJECT, DISPATCH, ESCALATE

fields.name: notes
fields.validation_rule: Audit comments or system decision reasoning

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Wall clock timestamp of event occurrence
